whatThisIs: Department of Immigrant Advancement “strengthens immigrants' ability to fully and equitably participate in Boston's economic, civic, social, and cultural life”. This office mainly offers resources and information to the immigrant community in Boston, including consultations with the office directly, resources to help find low-cost legal help, and community office hours that can help connect you to community support.
whoItHelps: Individuals looking for resources in Boston related to immigration, such as food, housing, immigration referrals, or family services.
Individuals looking to receive a free consultation with volunteer lawyers.
whatToKnow: Due to high demand, the free phone consultation service requires calling ahead to make an appointment.
MOIA has a thorough resource guide, offered in several languages, that can help direct you to resources in and around Boston.
Community office hours are located only at the East Boston Library or Copley Central Library branches.
name: Immigrant Advancement
